NoSQLServer v0.36 validation
============================

Focus
-----
Offset/navigation and distribution window functions.

New SQL surface
---------------
- LAG(value [, offset [, default]]) OVER (PARTITION BY ... ORDER BY ...)
- LEAD(value [, offset [, default]]) OVER (PARTITION BY ... ORDER BY ...)
- NTILE(integer) OVER (PARTITION BY ... ORDER BY ...)
- LAG/LEAD defaults: NULL, numeric literals, and quoted string literals.
- Offset zero is supported; negative/non-integral offsets are rejected.
- NTILE uses SQL bucket sizing: earlier buckets receive the remainder rows,
  and bucket numbers remain contiguous when bucket count exceeds row count.
- These ordered functions coexist with partition-wide aggregate windows when
  the ordered window definitions are compatible.

- Q02 LAG/LEAD with explicit offsets and defaults
- Q03 NTILE plus company-wide and department-wide aggregate windows
